note: Terra's profile — one of the owner's two named client profiles. It is identical to generic.json except for the debugging port and the transcript path, and that difference is the whole point: every attached agent starts its own Chromium, two of them on one remote-debugging port collide, and two of them writing one WITHHELD_BRIDGE_LOG overwrite each other's record of what was chosen. Terra owns 9571 and /tmp/withheld-bridge-terra.jsonl.
pairsWith: sol.json, which owns 9572 and /tmp/withheld-bridge-sol.jsonl. Run both at once and neither waits for the other, and each keeps its own transcript.
unverified: Terra is a client profile, not a program: it is defined nowhere in this repository, no run has ever been made with it, and nothing here describes what it can do. Point it at whichever CLI you actually run.
